Sample Senior Citizen Support Scheme (SSCSS)

Department of Example Social Welfare

Benefits

A monthly pension of Rs 800 is paid directly to the bank account of the beneficiary.

Eligibility

  • The applicant must be 60 years of age or above.
  • The applicant’s household must be Below Poverty Line (BPL).
  • The applicant must have lived in the state for at least three years.

Documents Required

  • Aadhaar card
  • Age proof
  • BPL card

How to apply

Submit the application form at the Gram Panchayat office.
